name: Flocking Dog 2024
paper_title: Collective responses of flocking sheep (Ovis aries) to a herding dog (border collie)
authors: V. Jadhav, R. Pasqua, C. Zanon, M. Roy, G. Tredan, R. Bon, V. Guttal, G. Theraulaz
mechanism: Topological random attraction/alignment, short-range repulsion, dog repulsion within Rd, grazing beyond Rd; dog Collect/Drive with f(N) and slowdown within r_a.
notes: Faithful to paper Methods / Fig. 7 and authors' MATLAB herding_model.m; Drive uses scenario goal instead of MATLAB origin.

assignment_modes.label: Collect: dog to outlier sheep being gathered.
Drive: dog to stand-off behind the flock.
